title: Kid vs. Kat
description: Kid vs. Kat is a Canadian-American animated television series developed and produced at Studio B Productions. The show was created and co-directed by Rob Boutilier. The series is distributed by Studio B Productions. The feature revolves around a 10-year-old boy’s constant battle with his sister’s Sphinx cat which, in reality, is a cybernetic alien.The show premiered on YTV in Canada on October 25, 2008, aired on Disney XD in the United States on February 21, 2009, and then ended on June 4, 2011. It ran for 2 seasons, spanning 52 episodes.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x1
episodes_data.description: Coop Burtonburger has his first run in with Kat when his little sister brings the feline home.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x2
episodes_data.description: Coop watches a horror movie, then after, Kat uses flour to make his skin white and scare Coop.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x3
episodes_data.description: Old Lady Munson lays down the law; Coop is not to set foot into her yard, but Kat makes sure he crosses the line again, again and again.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x4
episodes_data.description: After meowing too much, Kat is forced to wear a special collar, but in the end Kat straps the collar onto Coop's foot.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x5
episodes_data.description: Coop and Dennis build a tree fort, where Kat used it to power-up his collar because the tree's fort was very tall, so Kat's climbed it and starting communicating with other "Kats".

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x6
episodes_data.description: Coop gets accused of stealing cookies.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x7
episodes_data.description: Coop is determined to find out the truth about Kat when Kat's mysterious X-rays are destroyed.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x8
episodes_data.description: Coop comes up with a plan to rescue his dad's (possibly his) helicopter from Old Lady Munson.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x9
episodes_data.description: Tensions mount when Coop is sick and Kat is none too pleased, and why shall you ask? Because germs irritate Kat's skin.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x10
episodes_data.description: Coop finds some magic stuff in Dad's store and uses it to do a magic act to make Kat disappear forever.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x11
episodes_data.description: Kat's new toy mouse hypnotizes the other cats in the neighborhood, and Kat seizes the opportunity to create his own cat army.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x12
episodes_data.description: Coop convinces Dad that he's allergic to Kat so Dad will get rid of the pesky feline for good. Kat turns the tables on Coop, convincing Dad that he's allergic to Coop as well!

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x13
episodes_data.description: When Coop and Kat get glued hand to paw, they are forced to spend the day together. Kat turns out to be a big help in putting together Coop's new Mechanizor Warrior model robot until Coop realizes Kat has programmed it to destroy Coop, but Kat will also be destroyed.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x14
episodes_data.description: When a contest for pets is announced in Bootsville, Coop subscribes Kat because the winner wins a trip around the world. However, Coop regrets this when he realizes he will be taking the trip with Kat if he wins.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x15
episodes_data.description: As Coop prepares for a big test, Kat comes up with multiple ways to distract him from studying, which in the end, Kat ironically helps Coop remember the things he should study thus having a B+ on the test.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x16
episodes_data.description: Coop discovers a self-help motivational tape in the House of Swap and turns his life around, until Kat uses the tape to remove Coop’s new-found power of perfect positivity. Now it's up to Coop to use the tapes to fight evil Kat with an even more evil Coop!

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x17
episodes_data.description: Coop has his work cut out for him when he's forced to babysit Kat, Old Lady Munson, and her dog Growler.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x18
episodes_data.description: Coop comes up with a plan to make money for a Captain Blasteroid Helmet by cutting Old Lady Munson's lawn; Kat tries to stop Coop and Dennis by making the grass grow.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x19
episodes_data.description: The only way to convince Dad that Coop's not the one causing all the destruction is for Coop to never leave his father's sight. But this puts Dad and Millie right in the line of fire. Coop's got to keep on his toes if he wants his family to survive.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x20
episodes_data.description: Dad competes with Dennis' father as to who's the best camper during a family weekend in the woods. Coop and Dennis use their knowledge of the forest to lead Kat into escalating confrontations with nature.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x21
episodes_data.description: Bootsville's annual parade has a Spaced Out theme this year and Dad wants to advertise the House of Swap with a Flying Saucer float.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x22
episodes_data.description: Dad builds an ice palace and rink in the backyard.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x23
episodes_data.description: Kat takes advantage of Dad turning the House of Swap into a horror fun house by going for real blood.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x24
episodes_data.description: Coop brings home a carrot suspended in a glass of water for a science project.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x25
episodes_data.description: Egyptian artifacts at the museum turn out to be high-tech relics from Kat's world.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat 1x26
episodes_data.description: When Millie finds a new school friend exactly like her, she starts to ignore Kat.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Coop falls for Old Lady Munson’s niece Fiona, and Kat does everything he can to make Coop look bad.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: When Millie tickles Mr. Kat's 'tickle spot' he goes into a blissful state that renders him useless as an alien agent and when Kat's empire find out about him they send a robot to destroy Millie.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Kat's swarm of flea-sized mind control robots hop into the ears of the people of Bootsville and soon they all destroy Coop.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: With Coop out of town, Kat wants to turn water into milk and Dennis comes to the rescue.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Millie brings home the class hamster, unaware that Mr. Kat hates hamsters.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: When Kat uses his growth ray to bury Bootsville in a catnip jungle, Coop is blamed by the irate Bootsville Gardening Club.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Coop tries to stop the destruction of Massive Mart.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Kat builds a Rat-ray gun, which he plans on using to turn Coop into a rat, but Dad gets zapped instead, so Coop hopes he can change Dad back... If he can catch him first!

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Coop and Dennis climb inside Kat's scratching post and discover Kat's alien technology has created an infinity within.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Coop, Millie, and Dad are taken away to a top secret base to be interrogated, after a UFO investigator suspects they are aliens.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: After taking the fall for one too many of Kat's destructive escapades, Coop decides to let Kat have free rein to cause whatever destruction he wants.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Due to an ‘over-loading’ problem on the Kat Nebula, Kat plots to turn Bootsville Beach into a giant litter box.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Kat’s devious magnifier satellite is causing a dangerous heat wave in Bootsville.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Coop and Dennis compete with one another to reduce their carbon footprints.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Coop uses Kat’s time machine to go back to the past and stop Millie from bringing Kat home, but ends up altering the future for the worse.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Coop tries to undo the Kat invasion, which he brought about by fooling with Kat’s time machine.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Coop becomes Dennis’ wing-man for a change, as they go in search of the 'sewer-croc-baby'.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Coop breaks every window in Dennis' house, and is forced to work off his debt by working in Henry's store.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Growler swallows a Kat device which makes him grow to the size of a T-Rex.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Kat's malfunctioning spybot thinks Coop is its new master, and wants to protect him from Kat.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: The Kat Kommander's rebellious son runs away to Earth, where he becomes a handful for Kat, and a danger to the human race.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Dad accidentally swaps an assortment of Kat's weapons to the unwitting residents of Bootsville.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Kat is left at a kennel while the Burtonburgers go on vacation.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Kat becomes obsessed with making the biggest yarn ball ever made, and starts rustling sheep to gather their wool.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Dennis is accidentally knocked into a portal around the world.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Kat Season 2 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Kat makes himself invisible and causes trouble for Coop on the night he invites Fiona to dinner and when Dad invites Coop's teacher over for dinner.
